Subject: Re: Gifford

Hi Hannah,

I want to clarify my position directly, as there seems to be a misunderstanding.

I am not unhappy with the outcome, nor am I requesting any additional funds. My request is straightforward and reasonable: I am asking for formal documentation that clearly shows the cryptocurrency accounts have been fully liquidated.

To date, I have not received proper documentation confirming liquidation. The only materials provided have been screenshots reflecting account balances prior to liquidation, which do not verify that funds were actually withdrawn, transferred, or closed out. Screenshots of balances are not the same as transaction reports or liquidation records.

This is not a matter of greed or unnecessary conflict. It is simply a matter of transparency and compliance with the terms of the MDA. Given the nature of these accounts, there should be accessible records such as full transaction histories, withdrawal confirmations, or official reports from the platforms used. I am requesting those records.

I would also expect, from a legal standpoint, that verification of such claims would be based on documentation rather than verbal confirmation alone.

Please have your client provide complete transaction reports and documentation showing the liquidation of all cryptocurrency accounts, including transfers and final balances.

Thank you,  
Bethany Gifford
